Christian "'''Velocity'''" Birkeland is a Swedish CTF player. 

Velocity began his clan days in [[Boomstick Brothers]] and also played for [[Voodo]], [[NEC]] and [[First]]. 

Velocity is wide known for his speed and are one of the fastest CTF players ever. He is the ultimate flagrunner every team needs.

After a short break between 2003 to 2021, Velocity is back in form. He is one of the key profiles in getting the CTF scene back on table again.
